About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager (SPm), STACKTV App to own two critical levers within the STACKTV App ecosystem: audience engagement and monetization.

This SPm owns engagement from onboarding through conversion optimizing for audience watch time and multi-show engagement to diversify impressions and expand advertising reach. This SPm is responsible for defining the roadmap and delivering features that improve viewer engagement, content discovery, viewing frequency, retention drivers, advertising opportunities, and monetizable inventory across the STACKTV App platform.

Working closely with Engineering, UX and Design, Data Science, Analytics, Ad Operations, Sales, Programming, and Marketing teams, you will help shape the next generation of streaming experiences for Canadian audiences.

You will contribute by:

• Owning the audience engagement strategy and roadmap, developing product experiences that increase viewing behaviour, improve customer satisfaction, and build long-term engagement with the STACKTV App.

• Drive the product strategy for monetization, identifying opportunities to increase the commercial value of the STACKTV App while maintaining a premium and customer-focused viewing experience.

• Develop and evolve advertising products, including new ad formats, premium inventory, and advertising experiences that balance revenue objectives with the needs of the viewer

• Identify new revenue and viewer monetization opportunities, including commerce and interactive television experiences that create additional value for customers, advertisers, and the business.

• Optimize advertising performance and yield by using product insights, audience behaviour, and performance data to continually improve the effectiveness of advertising experiences across the platform.

You will translate business needs into clear product requirements and partner with data engineering, data science, and product teams from discovery through delivery and adoption. Responsibilities

Product Discovery and Strategy
• Develop a clear understanding of business strategies, workflows, challenges, and data needs.
• Lead discovery with stakeholders across sales, marketing, customer success, and other revenue-related functions.

Product Definition and Delivery

Data Quality and Product Performance
• Partner with engineering teams to establish expectations for data quality, reliability, access, and governance.

• Balance roadmap delivery with the operational needs of existing data products.
• Use adoption, quality, reliability, and business-impact measures to evaluate performance and guide improvements.

Stakeholder Leadership
• Build trusted relationships across business, product, data, and engineering teams.

• Align stakeholders around shared outcomes, priorities, and delivery decisions.

• Ability to use SQL or another relevant analytical or programming language to explore data, assess proposed solutions, or support product decisions.

• Experience partnering with data engineering, data science, analytics, or software engineering teams to evaluate technical options and guide product delivery.

Position Summary

The Finance ERP Product Manager leads business-side product management for SAP and related ERP capabilities. Reporting to the Manager, Finance Business Innovation Office (BIO), the role brings together Finance functional subject-matter experts to establish a coordinated business perspective on UHN’s SAP environment, make collective recommendations, and prioritize changes and enhancements based on business value, risk, controls, dependencies and user impact.

The role facilitates the Finance SAP user group and serves as a bridge among Finance process owners and users, BIO, Digital, Data & Analytics, project teams, vendors and implementation partners. The Product Manager is accountable for business product direction, governance, roadmap and backlog coordination, requirements facilitation, business validation and value realization. The FInance ERP Product Manager works in partnership with the Digital team, which retains accountability for technical architecture, configuration, integration engineering, deployment, production support and other technical decisions within its mandate.

In addition to ongoing SAP product management, the role contributes to assessments and implementation initiatives that integrate with SAP and may lead or support other priorities across the BIO portfolio. Assignments may evolve in response to Finance priorities, while remaining consistent with the role’s product-management, business-integration and portfolio responsibilities.

The ERP Product Manager is a proactive, collaborative leader who brings structure and direction to complex, cross-functional priorities. The successful candidate combines strategic product thinking with strong Finance business acumen and a high degree of technical curiosity. They are able to develop a strong working understanding of SAP, its configuration and data, and how it integrates with other systems and applications across the Finance landscape. They are comfortable learning how complex systems work, investigating dependencies and translating between business and technical perspectives so they can effectively challenge assumptions, assess impacts and collaborate with Digital and other technical partners. They are skilled at building consensus among stakeholders with different priorities and balancing business value, risk, urgency, controls and operational readiness. This is a unique opportunity to shape the direction of Finance ERP capabilities and improve how Finance teams use SAP to support reliable, efficient and sustainable operations at UHN.

Duties
• Establish and Facilitate the Finance SAP user group, including preparing decision materials, structuring discussions, documenting decisions and actions, and supporting transparent, collective prioritization across functional areas.
• Develop and maintain a business-led product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for SAP and related Finance ERP capabilities.
• Coordinate Finance process owners and functional subject-matter experts in defining business problems, requirements, business rules, controls, user needs and acceptance criteria.
• Assess enhancement requests using business value, strategic alignment, risk, urgency, control implications, user impact, dependencies, effort and operational readiness.
• Represent the Finance business perspective in discussions with Digital, Data & Analytics, vendors, system integrators and other delivery partners, while maintaining clear separation between business and technical accountabilities.
• Partner with Digital teams on feasibility, estimates, technical dependencies, integration impacts, release planning, implementation readiness and support requirements, developing sufficient understanding of SAP, its configuration, data structures and integrations to effectively assess impacts, challenge assumptions and collaborate on solutions.
• Support assessments and implementation projects involving interfaces or integrations with SAP, including current-state analysis, options assessment, future-state design, requirements, testing and transition planning.
• Identify cross-process and cross-application impacts involving workflows, master data, reporting, controls, integrations and downstream operations.
• Coordinate Finance participation in solution reviews, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, business readiness, go-live activities and post-implementation review; operational Finance retains accountability for business acceptance.
• Monitor product and capability health, including adoption, service performance, operational risks, enhancement outcomes, lifecycle needs and opportunities for continuous improvement.
• Ensure decisions, requirements, ownership, risks, limitations, support arrangements and transition expectations are documented and escalated through the appropriate governance forums.
• Contribute to vendor and partner governance by reviewing proposals, estimates, assumptions, risks, deliverables and knowledge-transfer requirements from a Finance product perspective.
• Support change-management, communications, training and adoption activities in partnership with Finance Change Management, operational leaders and subject-matter experts.
• Connect SAP and ERP priorities to the broader Finance capability map, transformation roadmap and BIO portfolio, identifying dependencies, overlaps and opportunities for coordinated delivery.
• Lead or support other assessments, products, projects and portfolio priorities assigned within BIO, applying product-management, business-analysis, facilitation and governance capabilities as required.

Qualifications
• Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Progressive experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, Finance systems, ERP implementation or enterprise application management.
• Demonstrated experience working with SAP or a comparable enterprise ERP environment supporting Finance processes.
• Experience facilitating cross-functional governance or user groups and building consensus among stakeholders with different priorities.
• Experience developing roadmaps, managing enhancement backlogs, documenting requirements and acceptance criteria, and coordinating business testing and readiness activities.
• Understanding of Finance processes, controls, workflows, master data, reporting and integration dependencies.
• Ability to work effectively with technical teams and vendors while maintaining clear business ownership and decision rights.
• Strong analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, documentation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• Ability to manage ambiguity, balance competing priorities and translate complex business and technology considerations into clear recommendations.
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA, Finance transformation, system integrations, healthcare, the public sector or another regulated environment is an asset.
• A relevant designation or certification, such as CPA, CBAP, PMP, SAP or product-management certification, is an asset.
